name: Alte Post
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Hotel Alte Post is centrally located in a charming Tiroler town. The rooms are neatly furnished with alpine-style decor. The building features a restaurant serving regional cuisine and a wellness area. The surroundings are ideal for hikers and winter sports enthusiasts. A standout feature is the historic interiors, which preserve the house’s traditional character. Guests will enjoy a peaceful stay with practical amenities and a warm, local atmosphere.
